# pbs_metric_server_influxdb_udp (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox Backup Server InfluxDB UDP metric server: an InfluxDB UDP listener — InfluxDB 1.x, or Telegraf's `socket_listener` in front of InfluxDB 2 or 3 — that PBS sends its metrics to as line protocol every 10 seconds: CPU, memory, network and disk usage of the host, and the usage of every datastore. UDP has no acknowledgement: metrics lost on the way go unnoticed.

On every create or update that leaves the server enabled, PBS resolves the host and connects a UDP socket to it before it saves anything, from its own host: a name the PBS host cannot resolve fails the apply. Nothing has to listen for that. Set `enable = false` to save a server whose name does not resolve yet.

InfluxDB HTTP and UDP metric servers share one namespace: `pbs_metric_server_influxdb_http` cannot take this name. Managing metric servers needs `Sys.Modify on /`, reading them `Sys.Audit on /`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Send PBS's metrics as line protocol to the UDP listener of InfluxDB 1.x —
# or of Telegraf's socket_listener input, in front of InfluxDB 2 or 3. PBS
# needs only to resolve the name before it saves the server; whether
# anything listens shows only in InfluxDB.
resource "pbs_metric_server_influxdb_udp" "telegraf" {
  name    = "telegraf"
  host    = "telegraf.example.com:8089"
  comment = "Telegraf socket_listener"
}

# A listener on a network with jumbo frames takes larger datagrams.
resource "pbs_metric_server_influxdb_udp" "lab" {
  name = "influxdb-lab"
  host = "[2001:db8::10]:8089"
  mtu  = 9000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Address of InfluxDB's UDP listener, `<host>:<port>`: a DNS name, an IPv4 address or an IPv6 address in brackets, and the port, such as `influxdb.example.com:8089` or `[2001:db8::10]:8089`.
- `name` (String) Metric server name, 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-`, not starting with `.` or `-`. InfluxDB HTTP and UDP servers share one namespace. Changing it replaces the server.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment, up to 128 characters on one line.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether PBS sends its metrics to the server. PBS resolves the host only while the server is enabled: set `false` to save a server PBS cannot reach yet. Defaults to `true`.
- `mtu` (Number) Largest datagram PBS sends, in bytes, 51 to 65535: PBS fills datagrams with up to this many bytes less 50, for the headers. Defaults to `1500`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `name`, present because Terraform requires an `id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = pbs_metric_server_influxdb_udp.telegraf
  identity = {
    name = "telegraf"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `name` (String) Metric server name, such as `influxdb-udp`.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = pbs_metric_server_influxdb_udp.telegraf
  id = "telegraf"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# InfluxDB UDP metric servers are imported by name, as Configuration → Metric
# Server in the web interface, or the pbs_metric_servers data source, shows
# it.
terraform import pbs_metric_server_influxdb_udp.telegraf telegraf
```
